operations.title: Corrected six-pin change of variables
operations.intent: pin Jacobian; six-pin; Y_r; r^-5; EC-014
operations.action: Form Y_r=T_r X_r using the stored six-row frame; det T_r=-r^-5 and p_X(x)=r^-5 p_Y(T_r x). Permutations may change the sign, not the absolute Jacobian.
operations.evidence: Exact determinant reconstructed with symbolic arithmetic this run; source status and closure record corroborate terminal narrow algebraic scope.
operations.exclusions: No covariance floor, r->0 limit, contact coefficient, selection or theorem promotion. r^-6 is not a universal forbidden exponent: a different dimension/frame may legitimately produce it.
operations.next_action: Retrieve the stored matrix and convention; do not re-expand it unless inputs or source identity change.

operations.title: Fold power cancellation
operations.action: (r^3/6) r^-5 r^2 = 1/6. Record every supplied factor separately before cancelling powers.
operations.evidence: Exact rational exponent identity checked this run; EC-014 terminal scope includes only this algebraic ledger.
operations.exclusions: The r^2 factor must be established in the caller. 1/6 is not a full contact coefficient or a proof of finite nonzero limiting mass.

operations.intent: lifetime; ell^-1/3; cubic gap; pushforward; r dr
operations.action: For fixed kappa>0, r dr = 6^(2/3)/(3 kappa^(2/3)) ell^(-1/3) d ell. Transform any amplitude at r=(6 ell/kappa)^(1/3) and retain the kappa measure.
operations.evidence: Local change-of-variables adapter derived and symbolically checked this run. Source pins supply the gap map; the input r dr measure is a required caller premise.
operations.exclusions: No full asymptotic from this Jacobian alone. Weighted mass, domination/tails, mark integration and selection bridge remain separate obligations.
operations.next_action: State the input measure and amplitude before using the exponent dictionary.

operations.title: Correct three-determinant Holder bound
operations.intent: Holder; Hölder; moment; determinant product; RN5
operations.action: E[|ABC| I] <= (E A^4 E B^4)^(1/4) (E C^2)^(1/2). No independence is needed. Require finite displayed moments for a useful finite bound.
operations.evidence: Standard Holder exponents sum to one; RN5 states the corrected rule and an exact counterexample to its predecessor. Algebraic control checked this run.
operations.exclusions: The universal inequality does not certify SIDE24 inputs, normalizer, spatial coverage or an r-uniform estimate.

operations.intent: cone integral; gamma; Gaussian cone; indicator elimination; LS-DER-060
operations.action: Form H=[[0,0,1/2],[0,-1,0],[1/2,0,0]]. Obtain eigenvalues lambda,-mu,-nu of Gamma H. With h=mu cos(phi)^2+nu sin(phi)^2, D=(1/(4pi)) integral_0^(2pi) [3lambda^2-4lambda h+8h^2-8h^(5/2)/sqrt(lambda+h)] dphi.
operations.evidence: Frozen body reproduced: fc2c35b1... / 8,873 bytes. Cap primitive and planar value 29/6-sqrt(6) checked symbolically here; the full field coefficient is not reverified.
operations.exclusions: Centered 2x2 matrix symmetry is essential. No noncentered substitution, arbitrary larger-matrix extension, selected-process bridge, complete outer quadrature certificate or novelty claim.
